audit.whatIsWrong: tldr and report[0] describe Ekko as an AD assassin who skips the shield. Every damage source in his kit is magic.
audit.why: Z-Drive Resonance, Timewinder, Parallel Convergence, Phase Dive and Chronobreak all deal magic damage, so Kassadin's passive magic reduction and Null Sphere's magic shield are both fully active here. Also: Parallel Convergence only stuns if Ekko himself enters the anomaly, so stepping off the circle disarms it.
audit.corrected: tldr and report[0] rewritten; cooldowns field now states the entry condition.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full layer gave Ekko rows 4 and 5 and 'Skill' at row 6 while content and the packet chart give Kassadin rows 4-6.
audit.why: Riftwalk is 5s at rank 1 against a 22s Parallel Convergence setup, so from 6 onward Kassadin leaves the zone that was his only lockdown.
audit.corrected: phases[4..6].side set to Kassadin to match content; whys[4] sharpened to state the same verdict.

audit.why: Spikes correctly seat Ekko at 3-5 and Kassadin from 6 onward.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page mentioned anti-heal despite Chronobreak healing a percentage of damage received.
audit.why: Chronobreak heals off the damage taken during the rewind window, so Grievous Wounds changes whether an all-in sticks.

edits.before: - Ekko Chronobreak: matchup-defining — Erases your kill and bursts back — track the hologram and save final damage for after it. Count it out loud if you must. - Your R Riftwalk has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Parallel Convergence is 22s at rank 1 and 14s at rank 5, and the anomaly only stuns if Ekko walks into it — leave the circle and he wasted 22s. - Chronobreak is 110s at rank 1 and 50s at max; hold your final damage for after the rewind. - Phase Dive is 9s.
